scope: Candidate F complete bounded code area for Observability & Resilience; source SHA256 host.go=9a07e02eb8592790dc8cbaef39f97b392403dcd6e10f7556444c2aa437980aca; host_test.go=639fd87f428cfe0da4a8ee700006bd9141c85c483669c1d16049ae658320282d

coverage.reason: Applicable: cancellation, stop propagation, failure containment, joining actual cleanup and errors.Is diagnostics are the available library signals. No service telemetry, retries or arbitrary timeout requirement is inferred.

findings.cause: The cohort context is unconditionally canceled when admission ends, even for a healthy full cohort or normal input closure.
findings.evidence: candidates/F/host.go:93; candidates/F/host.go:94; evidence/F-host-independent.log: healthy two-job cohort sees canceled context before release and returns both Run cancellation errors; evidence/F-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertions
findings.correction: Cancel only for an observed failure/caller stop; join normal Runs without canceling their work, then release leases.

findings.cause: A successful Open always calls Run without checking that stopping happened during acquisition.
findings.evidence: candidates/F/host.go:84; candidates/F/host.go:85; evidence/F-host-independent.log: callback cancellation-before-success still starts one Run; evidence/F-minimum-independent.log: same intended assertion; evidence/F-host-contract.log: held acquired-before-stop fixture detects forbidden Run
findings.correction: Record acquired lease ownership, observe stop before Run entry, and skip Run while joining/releasing all prior work.

findings.cause: Capacity is decremented on Run completion while the acquired lease remains unreleased until later cohort Close.
findings.evidence: candidates/F/host.go:38; candidates/F/host.go:61; candidates/F/host.go:103; evidence/F-host-independent.log: TestIndependentCompletedRunsRetainCapacity records peak=8 with limit 2; evidence/F-minimum-independent.log: same measured peak=8; evidence/F-host-race.log: three repeated peak=8 intended assertions
findings.correction: Track acquired leases and pending reservations through completed Close, and stop admitting once those owned slots reach limit; completion alone cannot release capacity.

strengths.evidence: Open/Run/Close errors remain inspectable at the caller-owned API rather than requiring telemetry or hidden process effects; cancellation of an idle input wait is exercised. Per-candidate failure containment consequences are reported separately.
